bio: I build payment systems that move real money at scale. Four years of building, breaking and scaling backend systems taught me how software fits together. Now I design products end to end and ship them fast, with AI as part of the toolkit. The tools and games here are where I build in public.
footerBio: Designed and built by Aman. Free tools and games, offered as-is: double-check anything important before you rely on it.
